//mode: billboard for art already drawn in perspective; ground only for flat plan drawings.
//source: A cut-out PNG of the base alone, in tools/skinforge/art/.
//relief: How much real depth is pulled out of the flat art. Raise height until the light rakes; too far and the image tears.
//emission: Brightest parts of the image glow. Lanterns and windows want this; a pale wall does not.
//motion: bob is in footprint units, sway in degrees, spin in full turns per loop.
//framing: lift nudges the subject down the frame if the headroom looks wrong.
